qa_pair.question: Among archived 2025 launch programs, find the one launched in the first quarter, then inspect its storage decision. What database product and major version was selected? Answer exactly as written.
Find the first-quarter public launch whose retrospective mentions a rollback, then inspect the linked closed incident. What severity was assigned? Answer with the severity label only.
Compare the approved budgets in all four archived program roots, then verify the lead in the highest-budget program's procurement decision. What is that lead's name?
Locate the supplier-onboarding program that launched without customer-visible downtime. Read its closeout metrics. To one decimal place, how many days was median onboarding time after launch?
Find the archived accessibility program, inspect both its conformance report and remediation register, and identify the minimum measured text contrast. Return only the ratio.
Within the accessibility program whose audit had no critical defects, inspect the participant study. How many participants completed every priority journey?

Find the infrastructure-efficiency program, verify that its legacy cluster retirement completed before savings verification, and report the independently measured annualized cost reduction. Return only the percentage.
Locate the migration runbook under the program whose security audit passed every required control. Who owned that runbook?
Across the archived program roots, which project had the earliest explicitly documented public launch date in its retrospective? Return the project title.
Find the closed security audit associated with a completed legacy-cluster retirement. How many required controls passed with no remaining exceptions?
